title: Vijay Sethupathi Reveals Why He Agreed To A Cameo In Rajinikanth Starrer Jailer 2 | Tamil Cinema News - News18
text: Vijay Sethupathi recently opened up about his special appearance in Jailer 2, revealing that his decision to be part of the Rajinikanth-starrer was driven purely by respect for the superstar. He confirmed that he has done a cameo in the much-anticipated sequel because he loves Rajinikanth a lot. Recently the actor spoke about being part of Rajini starrer. He said, “I have done a cameo in Jailer 2, because I love Rajinikanth sir. To be with him I get to learn a lot. Now I’m doing villain or cameo roles only in those scripts that excite me. I heard so many scripts, but many are approaching me for typical villain characters which I don’t want to do promoting a hero." Jailer 2 Update: Rajinikanth has confirmed that his much-anticipated film Jailer 2 will arrive only after June 2026. The actor, who was spotted at the airport en route to Kerala for a fresh filming schedule, gave fans a direct update on the movie’s progress and timeline. Speaking to the media, Rajinikanth revealed, “I am currently travelling for the Jailer 2 shoot. I am heading towards Kerala for a filming schedule, and it will consist of 6 days of shooting. I think the film will be completed by June next year, so the release will be after that." This update finally gives fans some clarity after months of speculation about when Nelson Dilipkumar’s sequel to the 2023 blockbuster would hit screens. What We Know About Jailer 2 Directed by Nelson Dilipkumar, Jailer 2 will see Rajinikanth return as ‘Tiger’ Muthuvel Pandian, facing an even more formidable set of challenges. Ramya Krishnan, Yogi Babu, and Mirnaa are reprising their roles from the first part, while new cast additions include SJ Suryah, Suraj Venjaramoodu, and Anna Rajan. The film is also bringing back cameos from Shiva Rajkumar and Mohanlal, with extended special appearances by Nandamuri Balakrishna and Mithun Chakraborty, making this sequel a star-studded affair. Music is once again composed by Anirudh Ravichander, whose pulsating background score was a highlight of the original. The Journey from Jailer to Jailer 2 The original Jailer (2023) shattered box office records, reaffirming Rajinikanth’s unmatched mass appeal and cementing Nelson as one of Tamil cinema’s most bankable directors. The sequel was officially announced in January 2025 with a short promo featuring Rajinikanth alongside Nelson and Anirudh, sparking immense anticipation across fan circles.
